d: Speaking at the ANI National Security Summit on the theme of Atmanirbharta and India’s preparedness for future wars, Chief of Defence Staff General N.S. Raja Subramani stated that national security now involves industry, startups, academia, and citizens alike. Citing ISRO’s resilient NVS-03 NavIC satellite launch and lessons from the Ukraine-Russia and Israel-U.S.-Iran conflicts, he highlighted how modern warfare relies on cheap mass-produced drones, space capabilities, artificial intelligence, and industrial depth.
